sections.heading: Data/Information Sharing Plan
sections.purpose: Describe how project data and information will be managed and made publicly discoverable and accessible.

required_elements.text: Describe the types of environmental data and information expected to be created during the project.

criteria.name: Importance/relevance and applicability of proposed projects to the program goals

objectives.text: Address whether proposed research activities can lead to improved understanding of NOAA-related science by society.
objectives.excerpt: (a) Can the proposed research activities lead to improved understanding of NOAA-related science by society?

objectives.text: Address the likelihood that scientific collaborations will develop research personnel across the full spectrum of NOAA-related sciences with stronger understanding of these sciences and NOAA fields of work.
objectives.excerpt: (b) What is the likelihood that the proposed scientific collaborations will develop research personnel across the full spectrum of NOAA-related sciences, with a stronger understanding of these sciences and NOAA fields of work?

objectives.text: Address the degree and quality of collaboration with multiple NOAA units throughout the project.
objectives.excerpt: (c) What is the degree and quality of collaboration with multiple NOAA units throughout the project?

criteria.excerpt: 1. Importance/relevance and applicability of proposed projects to the program goals. Maximum Points: 5. (Weight = 25%)

objectives.text: Address whether a sound strategy was developed to identify, develop, and manage the scientists who will enter the program and work with NOAA professionals across numerous science areas.
objectives.excerpt: (a) Was a sound strategy developed to identify, develop, and manage the scientists that will enter the program and work with NOAA professionals across numerous science areas?

objectives.text: Address whether focused scientific objectives and strategies, including data management considerations, project milestones, and timelines, were used.
objectives.excerpt: (b) Were focused scientific objectives and strategies, including data management considerations, project milestones, and timelines used?

criteria.name: Overall qualifications of applicants

objectives.text: Document past experience with identifying, developing, and managing numerous science support activities, including project coordination, logistics support, human resources support, and general business administration support, and demonstrate technical expertise to carry out the project.
objectives.excerpt: (a) Does the applicant clearly document past experience with identifying, developing, and managing numerous science support activities, including project coordination, logistics support, human resources support, and general business administration support and generally have the technical expertise to carry out the project?

objectives.text: Demonstrate the ability to conduct successful program management and coordinate varied research activities with numerous NOAA and external partners.
objectives.excerpt: (b) Has the applicant demonstrated the ability to conduct successful program management and coordinate a variety of different research activities with numerous NOAA and external partners?

criteria.excerpt: 3. Overall qualifications of applicants. Maximum Points: 5. (Weight = 30%)

objectives.text: Address whether there is a clear and efficient plan to identify, develop, and manage a variety of different research projects.
objectives.excerpt: (a) Is there a clear and efficient plan in place to identify, develop, and manage a variety of different research projects?

objectives.text: Demonstrate the ability to manage resources effectively through the proposed project plan.
objectives.excerpt: (b) Through the proposed project plan, does the applicant demonstrate the ability to manage resources effectively?

objectives.text: Address whether the project will support richer understanding and knowledge of NOAA-related science and its application to societal decisions.
objectives.excerpt: (a) Will the proposed project support result in a richer understanding and knowledge of NOAA-related science and the application of that science to support societal decisions?

objectives.text: Address whether research results will be communicated effectively to develop broader awareness and application.
objectives.excerpt: (b) Will research results be communicated in an effective way to develop broader awareness and application?
